analyst_view.overall: Javi Calleja's Eldense have lost three league games in a row without scoring, the latest 2-0 at Las Palmas to two stoppage-time goals. Sabadell drew 0-0 at home to Real Sociedad II on Monday and are 13th, four points off the play-offs; they are without Urri (suspended), Peque and Nicholas Gioacchini, one of their top scorers. Changed since the last view: LaLiga's figures show Sabadell are not a possession side and foul a lot, which turns my cards lean. No referee had been named when this was written.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.7 goals and I agree with a low figure. Eldense have not scored in three league games and Sabadell's games average under two goals (12-11 in 13). The site is already low, so I do not go lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. I have moved from higher to same: Eldense like the ball, but LaLiga counts Sabadell at only 4,320 passes in 13 games, so this is less of a two-way territorial battle than I thought. Nothing points clearly either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. I have changed my lean from lower to higher: LaLiga has Sabadell on 225 fouls committed in 13 games, far more than they receive, and 39 yellows, while Eldense have 35 yellows. A low-scoring game between two sides needing points should keep the tackles coming.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots. I have changed from higher to lower: LaLiga counts Eldense at 125 shots and Sabadell at 139 in 13 games each, and Sabadell are missing Gioacchini. Eldense's run without a goal suggests they are not creating much.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.2 shots on target and I leave it. Both teams create more than they convert: Sabadell drew a blank against Sanse on Monday and Eldense have not scored in three games.
